name: After § 16
title: REPORT European political parties and foundations – 2026 report on the application of Regulation (EU, Euratom) No 2025/2445 and on the activities funded
part_text: 16a. Calls on the Commission, in cooperation with the Authority for European Political Parties and European Political Foundations, to assess the administrative and compliance costs arising from reporting, documentation, audit and control requirements under Regulation (EU, Euratom) No 2025/2445 and, where appropriate, to propose simplification measures, including de minimis thresholds or simplified procedures for low-value financial contributions, while maintaining transparency and accountability;
